translation.name: Dillꞌ wen dillꞌ   Kob C̱he   Jesucrístonaꞌ

content: Be' Páblona' dill' lao Félixa'

Gok gay' lla zoa Páblona' Cesareana' ka bllin bx̱oz choo bx̱oz xenna', beena' le Ananías, na' nc̱hi'e baḻ beṉ' golka' chṉabia' na' kon to beṉ' wide dill', beṉ' le Tértulo. Na' bllingake' lao beena' chṉabia' kwenc̱he gaogake' xya c̱he Páblona'.

Na'ch bdegake' Páblona' lao beṉ' wṉabia'na' le Félix na' wzolo Tértulona' chawe' xya c̱he', chi'e: ―Chox̱keno' li', beṉ' wṉabia', zoanto' mbalaz na' chak wen c̱hento' lallnto'ni daa chak koo xṉezi yog'ḻoḻte kon yeḻ' sin' c̱ho'na'.
Na' daan, gattez zoanto' toshiizi nanto' li' chox̱keno' dii zan las, li' beṉ' wṉabia'.
Na' kwenc̱he bich wshayinto' li', chṉabinto' li' gono' goklen wzenago' to c̱hop ka nak dga iṉanto' li'.

Ka nak beeni ze lawo'ni, ṉezinto' nake' to beṉ' chbek dii zed, na' chdaze' doxen yell-lioni chta chṉie' beṉ' kwenc̱he neto' beṉ' Israel gaknto' c̱hoplə, na' ngoo lo nee x̱oṉj beṉ' chonḻilall' to beṉ' Nazaret.
Ga biyollin, goklallee kwee ḻoo yoodo'na' beṉ' bi nak beṉ' Israel. Daan bex̱'nto'ne'.
Na' wyaz beṉ' wṉabia' c̱he soldadka', beena' le Lisias, na' bigoyoe'ne' lo na'nto'na'.
Na' wne' neto' chiyaḻ' yidnto' lawo'ni kwenc̱he gaonto' xya c̱he'. Na' kwino' ṉaa, wak iṉabilo' Pábloni kwenc̱he iṉezilo' bic̱he chaonto' xya c̱he'.
Na' beṉ' Israelka' lle'lengake' na', bisc̱hopgake' dillaa che'gake': “Ka nakannan'.”

Na'ch beṉ' wṉabia'na' bene' seṉ lao Páblona' kwenc̱he wi'e dill', na'ch wzolo Páblona' chi'e: ―Ṉezid' ba gok zan yiz chono' yeḻ' josc̱his c̱he beṉ'ki lle' gani mbanilo'. Daan chibaid' wi'a dill' daa chak c̱ha' lawo'ni.
Zi' gok shlliṉ lla billin' Jerusalénna' jaye'lawaa Chioza', na' shi cheenilo' gakḻiyilo'n, wak iṉabo' kwenc̱he x̱enlalloo ka nakannan'.
Na' kono ble'i nad' chakdiḻ-len' beṉ' wa chbekw' wdiḻ wishesh ladj beṉ', ni ḻoo yoodo'na' ni gan yoblə ga chdop chllagnto' choe'ḻwillnto' Chioza' ni gachli yella'.
Na' ka nak diiki na beṉ'ki c̱ha', ni ton bi gongake' gan iṉagake' ka nakannan'.

Ḻete to dii wc̱heb' lawo'ni choe'lawaa Chioza', beena' be'la'o dii x̱ozxto'nto'ka', kon ka nak nez ḻi nez shao' c̱he Jesucrístona' daa yo'a, daa na beṉ'ki bi zejan shḻi. Per chajḻi'a yog' daa na ley c̱he Chioza' na' diika' bzej dii beṉ'ka' wdix̱jee daa golle' ḻegake'.
Na' ka beṉ'ki chao xya c̱ha' na' ka nad', toz ka nonnto' lez yisban Chioza' beṉ' wetka', ka beṉ' wen ka beṉ' mal.
Daan chon' byen yixi yiyech yic̱hjlall'dawaani, ḻa' cheenid' bibi doḻ' gap' lao Chioza' ni lao beṉ' yell-lioni.
’Ba gok zan yiz chda' yell zit'ka', na' billin' Jerusalénna' kwenc̱he wi'a mech dii gaklenan beṉ' wlall c̱ha'ka' na' ḻekzka' wi'a bi dii wi'a yoodo'na'.
Na' diikin chon' ka biyoll bixi biyech' kon ka na leya', kat' to c̱hop beṉ' Israel, beṉ' zaak Ásiana', ble'gakile' nad' yoodo'na'. Aga no beṉ' ntop nshag' na' ni to wdiḻ wishesh bi mbek'.
Ḻegaken' chiyaḻ' yidgake' ni gaogake' xya c̱ha' shi bin ble'gakile' chon'.
Wa beṉ'ki zoa ni, iṉashkigake' shi bi dii mal billelgakile' c̱ha' kana' jwa'gake' nad' lao beṉ' wṉabia' c̱hento'ka'.
¿Awa shi daa besyaa goshgakee: “Chaozle xya c̱ha' daa chajḻi'a wllin lla yiban beṉ' wetka'”?

Na' ka biyoll beni Félixa' wna Páblona' ka', na' bsane' bich bene' yeḻ' josc̱his c̱he'na', ḻa' ba wṉezile' nakan nak diika' chajḻe' beṉ'ka' yoo lo nez ḻi nez shao' c̱he Jesucrístona'. Na' golle' beṉ'ka': ―Kat' yid Lísiaza', beena' chṉabia' soldadka', kana' iṉezyeṉ'id' nakran nak dga chak c̱hele.
Na'ch Félixa' golle' x̱an soldadka' wseje' Páblona', per bi wllone' sho' beṉ'ka' nombia' ḻe' na' llje'gake'ne' bi dii chyalljile'.

Na' ka wde c̱hop shoṉ lla, bizllinlen Félixa' xoole'na' le Drusila, to nool Israel. Na'ch ben Félixa' mandad bllin Páblona' lawe'ka' kwenc̱he wzenaggake' dillaa daa cho'e daa ne' chiyaḻ' gonḻilall'cho Jesucrístona'.

Na'ch be' Páblona' dill' chi'e chiyaḻ' goncho byen goncho wen na' bi goncho daa nazan c̱hecho, ḻa' wllin lla yizi' Chioza' kwent c̱he to tocho. Na' ka beni Félixa' xtilleena', ḻe bllebe'. Na'ch golle' Páblona': ―Ba gokz to ka't', na' kat' gat' latj c̱ha'na' iṉia' li' dii yoblə.
Félixa' ḻekzka' goklallee we' Páblona' ḻe' mech kwenc̱he yisane'ne'. Daan zekizezi wṉie'ne' kwenc̱he be'lene'ne' dill'.
Ka'z wde c̱hop yiz, na' ka bichej Félixa' bich wṉabi'e na' wyoo to beṉ' yoblə lie' Porcio Festo. Na' kwenc̱he ile'shii beṉ' Israelka' Félixa', bi bisane' Páblona'.
